name: Timestamp Converter
tagline: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back
description: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds since 1970-01-01) to readable date/time strings, or parse a date string into a Unix timestamp. Supports UTC and local time display. Instantly shows the current timestamp.

expert_defs.name: timestamp_converter_convert
expert_defs.description: Converts Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa. Params: value (timestamp integer or date string), direction (ts_to_date/date_to_ts/now). Returns JSON with output_type json containing timestamp, utc and iso fields.
code: if not dt: return json.dumps({'status': 'error', 'message': 'Could not parse date. Use YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'})
result = {'unix_timestamp': ts, 'utc': dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'), 'iso8601': dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'), 'readable': dt.strftime('%B %d, %Y at %H:%M:%S UTC')}

conceptTexts: Plugin: Timestamp Converter (id: timestamp-converter). Expert timestamp_converter_convert converts between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates. Params: value (timestamp or date string), direction (ts_to_date/date_to_ts/now). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {unix_timestamp, utc, iso8601, readable}}.
